payload.claim: Revisit on the Q4 2026 / FY2026 results and 2027 capex plan. Thesis-negative: operating margin falling materially below the Q2-Q3 2026 level, or DRAM/HBM contract prices turning down despite the LTAs; further HBM share loss to Samsung in the next share data, or HBM4 failing to overtake HBM3E in Q4 2026 as guided; non-renewal of the US licence for the Wuxi fab; an ITC initial determination for an import ban in 337-TA-1492; or the Garciaguirre case or the Cheongju criminal referral escalating the integrity gate. Thesis-positive: LTA coverage extending beyond 2028 with price terms, not only volume; the code's fair value rising so that the margin of safety turns materially positive at both measured betas; and a sourced explanation of the 22.92 trillion won valuation loss and of the price fall since 28 October.

prediction.reasoning: Q3 2026 ran at an 80% operating margin, LTAs cover more than 50% of 2027-2028 capacity, volumes are described as sold out through 2029, and brokers expect DRAM ASPs to keep rising into Q1 2027, so I expect the next full fiscal year after FY2026 to stay well above FY2025's 48.59% even with heavier 2027 depreciation and Samsung's HBM gains. Where I depart from the price: the bear reading (iM Securities) is that the price already discounts a sharp earnings decline, and I do not see that turn arriving within this horizon; the 2028 call itself is beyond what the evidence supports.
